naturalControl.head: 91a26c50cb17d4161516c75ab987d083752d6ef2
naturalControl.reason: The natural prompts have no progress/read/output guidance, but the Bot structural approval gate rejects bash with "这个对话与 App 的身份登记已失效或未完成" while glob/read succeed. ACT-05/06 never read their seeds; ACT-05 was temporarily (and wrongly) marked PASS by a weak reply regex matching the refusal text, which is rejected. ACT-04 eventually read both seeds through glob/read after the bash rejection and gave the correct conflict answer, but the natural control as a whole is not a pass and does not prove default-prompt behavior.

scenarios.detail: first bash call rejected by the identity gate; the model retried with glob and read, read 174-notes.md/main-notes.md, and answered 3 conflicts. The activity sequence is therefore real but includes the failure and object fallbacks, not a clean natural progress sequence.
the bash call was rejected; the model gave up and showed next steps. A weak regex matched the refusal prose (周三例会/待办); that PASS is rejected.
the natural loop was stopped after the meeting failure; no seed read and no accepted activity evidence.

naturalControl.nextStep: Bot runtime owner diagnoses the bash/file-access identity-registration boundary; do not bypass the gate or relax the assertions. Natural evidence must be rerun on the fixed head before claiming default-prompt effectiveness.
